personas.title: Personal versions
personas.summary: How a version of the investor site is made for one person and unlocked with a key in a link or QR code; five fictional personas to try it.
personas.lead: One site, a version for each person we write to: in their language, their route through the decks, a note, even slides changed for them. It opens with a key in a link or a QR code.
how: Dinis Cruz names a person and says why they matter; an agent writes their version from public, professional facts and his note.
The version is locked with its own key. The locked file is public; the key is only in the link and its QR code.
The person scans or clicks. Every page of the site then speaks to them, until they close the tab or leave the version.
Nothing about them is stored on the site, and the link's key never reaches a server.
personas.try_lead: Click a link, or scan the QR code with a phone.
personas.drop_title: Have a QR code as an image?
personas.drop_lead: Drop it here, or choose the file: the page reads it and opens the version.
personas.drop_nodetector: This browser cannot read QR codes from an image: open the link instead, or scan with a phone.
personas.drop_none: No PrompTugal version link found in that image.
personas.real: Their version is made only at Dinis Cruz's request, holds only public and professional facts and his own note, and its link goes to him alone, never to this public site.
personas.status: Opening a version needs the site's small script for personal versions, which is waiting for the developers' review; until it is served, the links open the site as usual.
